fix(url-handler): a click no longer takes the terminal's keyboard focus (#606)

* fix(url-handler): a click no longer takes the terminal's keyboard focus (candybar-daemon-health-ajx0.p04)

The forwarder was an agent app (LSUIElement). Launch Services activates an
agent to deliver a link, and a resident app keeps the focus it was given, so
every click on a bar link took keyboard focus from the user's terminal and
broke the settings menu. The old applet quit after each click, which returned
focus to the previous app and hid this.

The Info.plist now declares the app background-only, which Launch Services
never activates. A background-only copy still received and forwarded links,
and still raised the notification-authorization prompt for a lost click.

The notification delegate existed only because the app was frontmost when it
posted, and macOS hides a frontmost app's banner. The app is never frontmost
now, so the delegate and its comment are removed.

* docs(url-handler): say why the lost-click banner needs the app never frontmost (candybar-daemon-health-ajx0.p04)
